snippet.title: [RF Online Next] Meet the Biosuit : Phantom
snippet.description:
Introducing the Phantom!

Boasting staggering combat speed, the Phantom specializes in rapidly closing in on and assassinating enemies. Using Dash and Plunder skills, it excels in one-on-one combat and can overcome enemies with heavy defenses and dismantle enemy positions in an instant.

Deal lethal attacks with lightning-fast agility to swiftly dispatch enemies—experience the Phantom biosuit's combat capabilities today!#rfonlinenext
